bug_semantics: QuantizedModelLoader.load_quantized_model_pt() (alias onecomp.load_quantized_model_pt) loads a caller-selected directory's model.pt with torch.load(..., map_location='cpu', weights_only=False). That path uses Python pickle, so a crafted checkpoint with a malicious __reduce__ runs arbitrary code (CWE-502) when the library loads it. Vendor SECURITY.md and CVE-2026-73325 mark v1.2.0 and earlier affected; v1.2.1 refuses the load unless allow_unsafe_deserialization=True and warns before the remaining pickle load. The safetensors load_quantized_model() path is not this sink.
flaw_origin: The pickle sink was first written as a new API, not a later regression: bc9f97c215b0576c2d22854263d08b2020fbf5a7 added load_quantized_model_pt() as the counterpart to Runner.save_quantized_model_pt() so LoRA-preserved custom modules (e.g. LoRAGPTQLinear) could be restored, and it called torch.load with weights_only=False unconditionally, with no trust/opt-in gate.
